changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 5 item 8: moved daemon/restart-intent.ts to service/dispatcher-service/restart-intent.ts, closing the inversion where service/dispatcher-service/{index,restart-notice,input-source-lifecycle}.ts and service/dispatchers/index.ts (core) imported it from daemon/ (an operator-surface directory). daemon/ and cli/commands/daemon.ts now import from service/dispatcher-service/, the correct direction. The persisted restart marker JSON shape (RestartIntentFile: version, created_at_ms, ttl_ms, announce, targets) is completely unchanged; this is a code-location move only. Also corrected a stale doc-comment sentence referencing a deleted dispatcher.start admin command with the actual current lazy agent-runtime-activation scenario.
